venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL beat target +24.6% ($1,953 vs $1,567) on Memorial Day Monday.** MDW brought in more than average for a Monday. Food $322. Comps $116.48 ($18 DNL, $8 emp discount, $26 industry love, $8 mgr comp, $29.98 marketing, $26.40 O4W). 52 guests / $37.56 GCA. **'Busy at the start — full bar till about 9:30 and almost all of the 4-top booths were full during that time. 10pm till close we had the bar 70% full with a booth or two occupied. Opener was able to hold it down till closer came in to support. Saw some action on the vending machine today! Mid was able to package and inventory merch tonight. We also had an IG influencer join us — they raved about the hot dogs and the beanie babies in the vending machine! Overall smooth night despite the rolling rain storms that were on and off all day/night long. G'night from Atlantis.'** **Kitchen**: 'Great job with ticket times and cleaning projects, clean service and clean close.' **86**: Wings. No incident, no no-shows charged. **Highlight**: 'Seeing a lot of curiosity from guests on our vending machine as well as hosting the IG influencers!' MOD: MKZ. Entered by MKZ.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH ANNIHILATED target +343.2% ($2,557 vs $577) on Memorial Day Monday** — a lively, fun holiday close-out. Steady right out of the gate, picked up until slowing at ~7:45pm; remained even-paced the rest of the night. Food $427. Comps $194.10 (7.5%) — industry, investor, birthday. 71 guests / $36.02 GCA. **'Everyone's spirits were high. Numerous Meal Deals/food in this timeframe. Guests appear enthusiastic about the menu and are eager for the jalapeno poppers. Myriad industry guests, including first-timers, and a birthday party from 888 and Bourbon Steak. We hosted an investor and their partner from ~11pm until a little after close. They were lovely, inquisitive, and departed happy.'** **Kitchen**: 'Korey and Kevin held it down in the kitchen and kept the buzzers buzzing. Service was expedient and consistent.' **Maintenance**: kitchen door lock. **86**: Jalapeno Poppers, Veggie Dogs, Super Martini, Montenegro. **Low**: Pickers, Lairds, Los Monteros, Cider. No incident, no no-shows charged. **Highlight**: 'A group of younger industry guests joined us this evening for the first time. They work ~45 minutes away, in the middle of nowhere, and had been planning on joining us for some time. They were the sweetest and enthusiastic about every aspect of their experience. Quite humbling.' MOD & Chef: KE // KC / KM. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR -19.5% vs target ($7,066.78 vs $8,778.70)** — busy MDW weekend yielded a very slow holiday Monday. Segments: DC/AM $1,349.39, D&C PM $5,717.39, Garden/6A $1,275.66. Food $2,157.10 (30.5% mix). Comps $115.02 (1.63%). 108 guests (Tock) / $65.43 GCA. **DC/AM (Maggie)**: NA. **D&C (Carey)**: 'Unfortunately slow night across the board. Low garden attendance, but all but one reservation showed up. Busy holiday weekend yielded a very slow holiday day.' **Garden/6A**: 'No notes from Garden. Jordan, please don't copy and paste — we truly want to know about the night.' **Kitchen (Archer with Marv and Antonio)**: 'Slow Memorial Day, but the orders we got were big. Nice day with Marv and Antonio. THANK YOU ARCHER.' Break makeup complete. No incident, no no-shows charged. **Highlight**: 'Our favorite Monday regular Investor Kevin came in and spent the majority of his night with Reagan & then Kim at the bar. Shout out to our team for seeing a huge supporter of what we do, and keeping them coming back for more. Solid Hospitality!!!' MOD: Maggie (AM) / Carey (PM). Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV -28.3% vs target ($3,414 vs $4,761)** — relaxed Memorial Day Monday. Food $445 + Bev $2,913; D&C Net Sales $3,414. 96 guests (Sevenrooms) / $36 GCA. Comps $213.38 ('Mothers Drink Free' @ Max plus industry friends — outlier). **'Tonight had a cold open, and I don't mean in the SNL sense. More like, 11 covers until 7:30, like I'm downstairs organizing the liquor room to keep my hippocampus from dissolving. Lots of artists on this salon Sunday, including a few who cold-asked me if I knew a post-Felix-Gonzalez-Torres relational-aesthetics artist from Denver (I did). 4 large parties (all marauding one-and-dones), 3 solos, 4 investor cocktails.'** Top sellers: Material Control, Fries, First Time Listener. **Kitchen**: 'Lack of oysters offers a test case in alternative martini pairings. The clear winners are cheese plate and fries!' **Door (HP)**: 'A relaxed Memorial Day with nice warm weather and just slightly humid. Very slow open with only a few tables; thankfully things picked back up at 8pm, briefly full and then around half full at 10pm. The Knicks game may have been a cause to a slow open but it also didn't give us the usual mid-point lull — heard a resounding cheer throughout the streets when they won. Handful of large parties came in tonight of friends getting together for the holiday off, but overall trendy with duos celebrating anniversaries and birthdays. At 11pm the streets quieted down and were almost empty by midnight. Welcomed Max bringing her mom in, plus friendly faces Dominick and Katin Shalit.' **No-shows charged**: Yes — Zeyn Burak (2 @ 6:30pm) and Tergel Molom-Ochir (2 @ 8pm). **Menu count**: 17. **Glassware**: tulip, DOF, cheater. **Thread note (Thomas, after report)**: 2 mice spotted by Dante and Tenzin in the kitchen — escalated to Cara Chavez. MOD & Chef: Cara & Alejandro. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Good weather, no effect on service
venues.narrative: **LA -12.5% vs target ($3,485 vs $3,984) on Memorial Day Monday.** Marquee $3,485 (only — Standing Room closed). Food $881 (25.3% mix). Comps $216.74 — Griffin, Bailey & Clark (bday), Meech and Edwino, DNL, employee food discounts. 94 guests / $37.07 GCA. **'Started off smooth. The night picked up slightly where we started a waitlist for all of 10 minutes and then were able to bring everyone down and call back waitlist guests all within 20 minutes. Many people closed out and wrapped up at the same time freeing us up to accommodate everyone who was still around to come back. Short spurt of fast service, then trickled back down to a very manageable pace quickly.'** **Slower Oyster Monday than prior Mondays — sold around 120 oysters nonetheless.** Cranked out 17 new menus ready for tomorrow's menu flip (5 need inserts to complete). **'The tasting we did today was super helpful to grasp the concept of a lot of what's gonna be on this menu! Looking forward to launch this new spring/summer menu tomorrow.'** Had a couple no-shows charged tonight; also a couple guests who emailed they could not make it — those weren't charged. **Kitchen**: 'Sold around 120 oysters but nothing Vic couldn't handle. No lows or 86's that were communicated.' **86**: Aberlour A'bunahd, Aval Cider, Highland Park Hazy, Yellow Chartreuse. No incident. **Highlight**: 'Bailey and Clark celebrating Clark's big 30.' MOD & Chef: Mikey, Vic + Josh. Entered by Mikey. *(Note: typeform 'Today's Date' field entered as 2026-05-26 but report was filed at 03:59 EDT Tuesday morning and narrative references Tuesday menu flip — this is the Monday 5/25 service report.)*

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DCDC narrowly beat target +5.7% ($1,872.13 vs $1,771.00) on Memorial Day Monday.** D&C Marquee Bar Sales $2,081.08 (gross); Garden closed. Food $151.62 (7.3% mix). Comps $17.40 (0.9%), no voids. 38 guests / $35.32 GCA / $74.89 CA. **'Slow night in DC, as expected with the weather and people being out of town for the holiday weekend. We had a couple reservations and walk-ins earlier in the evening before hitting a full lull around 7:30pm. During the downtime, we cut the host and focused on new-menu to-dos until things picked back up closer to 10pm. Service overall ran very smoothly, with everyone pitching in and helping wherever needed throughout the shift.'** **Kitchen**: 'Snacks only.' **What went well**: 'Teamwork.' **What we can do better**: 'No candles on dirty trays.' Kitchen close checked. No incident. No-shows charged. **Maintenance**: same as prior nights (water from kitchen ice machines; water heaters; missing elevator key still outstanding). **Highlight**: 'New menu to-dos!' MOD: Josh. Entered by Josh. *(Note: Sunday 5/24 EON still outstanding — no DC submission for 5/24 found in #dc_eon_report.)*

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG -8.2% vs target ($6,426 vs $7,000) on Memorial Day Monday.** Segments: MB Morning $2,716 (33 covers), MB Evening $3,433 (107 covers), Sun Club $376, Hot Eye closed. Food $2,895 (45.0% mix — strong). Comps $519 — $118 walk-out due to check-presentation confusion (check #95, server Tia — guest filled in tip/total for room charge but never left a card; new check format is confusing); David Little (Savannah Distributing) and Victoria full comp. ~140 MB OpenTable guests / $45.90 GCA. **Morning (Sam & Shannon)**: 'A mellow start to the morning with a few scattered tables before 10. We were well staffed for a busy breakfast and lunch but it was not meant to be. Only a couple of departures had breakfast with us. A decent pre-happy-hour crowd but we rocked it no problem. No issues with ticket times in the kitchen and the team did great.' **Evening (James & Marcus)**: 'Decent end to the holiday weekend. Had plenty of staff to field the steady volume throughout the shift. Emily Fredock followed and trained with Tia. Cuts happened a little later than usual because of the steadiness of volume and because Tia helped on expo a little bit. Guests were happy and service was good.' **Sun Club**: 'Not super busy at Sun Club due to it being hot but not necessarily sunny, and lots of checkouts.' **Hot Eye**: Closed. **Kitchen**: 'Kitchen did great this evening despite being down a person. Everyone pitched in at some point to run food and Tia expo'd for a bit when it was at it's busiest.' No incident. **Maintenance**: 'Well 1 needs to be repaired ASAP. CO2 tank needs to be changed for bar crysalli — the grey tank next to the attached one is full. I do not have the tools to change the tanks — maybe we should have an appropriately sized wrench handy. Easy fix for anyone with the correct tools.' **Highlight**: 'David Little (Savannah Distributing tech wizard / connection producer / account expenser extraordinaire) and Victoria had a lovely business dinner/date at 45. Great to see both of them enjoying the space and getting along so swimmingly.' — James. Entered by James.
